checks: Responsible for identifies the goods under the movers’ responsibility. Other prepositions do not work here; corrected the keyed Chinese gloss so it does not duplicate the verb in the passage.

activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [144].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [144] 的字詞或句子。

options.whyZh: responsible at 不表示對設備與檔案負責。
responsible with 不符合此處對搬運物品負責的搭配。

options.zh: 對（與 responsible 搭配，表示對……負責）
options.whyZh: be responsible for 是表示對某事負責的固定搭配。
by 可接被動施事者，但 responsible 是形容詞，應接 for。

group.title: Office relocation notice
group.passage:
Dear colleagues,

Our customer service team will move to the third floor on April 12. Please label each box with your name and desk number so that the movers can place it [143] ____.

Personal valuables should be carried by their owners. The moving company is responsible only [144] ____ packed office equipment and files. [145] ____

On moving day, incoming calls will be handled by our regional office. Normal telephone service at this site will [146] ____ at 9 a.m. the following morning. Thank you for your cooperation.
